name: Wellness Exams
shortDescription: Regular checkups that help catch health issues early and keep your pet thriving.
description: Preventive care is the foundation of a long, healthy life for your pet. A wellness exam includes a nose-to-tail physical evaluation, weight and body-condition scoring, dental and skin checks, and a wellness plan for your pet's life stage — from playful puppies and kittens to cherished senior companions. Catching problems early often means easier treatment and more healthy years together.
features: Early detection of common health issues
seoDescription: Pet wellness exams in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Preventive checkups that help keep your pet healthy at every life stage.

name: Surgery & Procedures
shortDescription: Surgical care, from routine spay and neuter procedures onward, with attention to your pet's comfort.
description: Surgery can feel daunting, so we explain each step and what to expect. Care before, during, and after a procedure focuses on your pet's safety and comfort, and we stay in touch with you so you know how your pet is doing and how to help them recover at home.
seoDescription: Veterinary surgery and spay/neuter in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}, with attention to your pet's comfort before, during, and after.

name: Dental Care
shortDescription: Dental care that protects your pet's teeth, gums, and overall health.
description: Dental disease is common in pets and can lead to pain, tooth loss, and problems elsewhere in the body. Dental care includes professional cleaning and polishing, evaluation of the teeth and gums, and treatment when needed — plus coaching on at-home care so your pet keeps a healthy smile between visits.
seoDescription: Veterinary dental care in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} — cleanings and dental treatment to protect your pet's health.

name: Vaccinations & Prevention
shortDescription: Tailored vaccine schedules plus flea, tick, and heartworm prevention to shield your pet from preventable disease.
description: Vaccines and year-round parasite prevention are among the most effective ways to protect your pet. A vaccination plan is based on your pet's species, age, lifestyle, and risk, and prevention also covers flea, tick, and heartworm protection, along with microchipping so your companion can find their way home if they ever wander.
seoDescription: Pet vaccinations and parasite prevention in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Tailored vaccine schedules plus flea, tick, and heartworm protection.

name: Internal Medicine & Diagnostics
shortDescription: Diagnostics and ongoing care for chronic conditions, with a clear treatment plan.
description: When your pet isn't feeling well, answers matter. Diagnostic testing helps find the cause, and for chronic conditions like diabetes, kidney disease, thyroid disorders, and allergies we partner with you on a long-term care plan that keeps your companion comfortable.
features: Diagnostic testing to find the cause
seoDescription: Veterinary diagnostics and internal medicine in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}}. Testing and chronic-disease management for your pet.
